newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Primakov arrives in Brussels for NATO talks.
newsitem.headline: Primakov arrives in Brussels for NATO talks.

text.p: Russian Foreign Minister Yevgeny Primakov arrived in Brussels on Sunday for talks with NATO Secretary-General Javier Solana on a new NATO-Russia charter or treaty.

Primakov, who was met at Brussels' s airport by Moscow's envoy to Belgium Vitaly Churkin, declined to speak to waiting journalists. He is due to meet Solana on Sunday evening for four hours of talks on a new relationship between the two former Cold War foes to accompany the alliance's eastwards expansion.
Primakov's plane taxied to a private and secluded corner of Brussels international airport.
NATO and Russia have put a news blackout on the talks which are due to take place at Solana's private residence later on Sunday.
Solana is expected to push Primakov to give more details on what Russia can bring to plans to set up some form of permanent consultative mechanism with NATO.
